item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Science Fiction

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch:

  • An crystal, that makes you have abilities similar to SCP-076
  • It is a safe object, with Euclid containment procedures due to constant illegitimate use of the object

Central Narrative: This SCP, is basically a crystal, that when someone approach it to the person's chest's, a gunge, start to take the user's body, later transforming it self into an outfit, and make's you have super human capabilities

The user of this SCP, may, keep weapons of his desire, in a "layer", that the user may retrieve them at any time…

people who got to use the SCP, if they die they shall desintegrate them selfes, and in 3-7 days, they will get back, to a coffin, similar to SCP-076 but it highly depends on the user

the foundation formerly let the object either on a wood box, or in a cylindrical base, until there were people taking instances of this SCP1, making the foundation having to strict the containment procedures, but remaining, the object as a safe-class, since this isn't a containment problem but a non authorized usage problem…

Foundation Personal to use this SCP will need permission of the O5-2 to be given the key of this SCP, and use it for them selfes or for the Foundation purposes

there are 2 types of this instances, there are Purple crystals and red crystals, altough there is no difference between those two

The method of containment for this SCP is a metal restraint locked by key.

I seek feedback and criticism thanks…
